mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days in any economic regime.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strong employment growth (PAYEMS > 100000) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) indicate a tight labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of PAYEMS > 100000 and UNRATE < 4.0 fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 900 thousand units (HOUST > 900) during a housing boom regime signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 900.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO growth > 0.5% MoM) indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days in any regime.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO growth > 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 900 thousand units (HOUST > 900) signal strong residential construction activity that boosts consumer confidence and economic momentum, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 900.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1 annualized > 1.0%) combined with high housing starts (HOUST > 900) signals robust economic expansion that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of GDPC1 > 1.0% annualized and HOUST > 900 fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) during a tight labor market regime supports wage growth and consumer spending, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0.
